li.label: Dovahkiin
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries the soul of a dragon in a mortal body. [PAWN_pronoun] can learn the Thu'um, and the world has begun to react to [PAWN_objective].\n\nDragons hate [PAWN_objective] on sight - tamed or allied makes no difference.

li.label: dragonblood
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is descended from a Dovahkiin. The blood is thinner, but it is there - [PAWN_pronoun] learns quickly, carries [PAWN_possessive] self well, and notices things others miss.\n\nIt is not the Voice. But should the world ever be without a Dragonborn, it may yet be [PAWN_objective].
